summary: A software outage on the line shut down Wacky Wheels Lexington from 2027-03-16 to 2027-03-18. To handle the outage, 9 production orders were rescheduled at the same plant, 32 dealers were notified once each regarding 79 customer orders, and 18 loaners were assigned.
decision_reason: The system acted because this was a confirmed incident where IDs and dates resolved against the data, handbook validators passed, and the sandbox pre-flight check cleared. In addition, the auditor confirmed operational policy compliance, and the live world matched the planning baseline across 5 slot reads and 16 pool reads prior to the first write.
